rounds.name: Strait of Gibraltar
rounds.fact: The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates Europe from Africa.

rounds.name: Sinai Peninsula
rounds.fact: The triangular Sinai Peninsula serves as the land bridge between the continents of Asia and Africa.

rounds.name: Baja California
rounds.fact: The narrow Baja California peninsula separates the Pacific Ocean from the Gulf of California.

rounds.name: Cape of Good Hope
rounds.fact: The Cape of Good Hope marks the rocky headland on the Atlantic coast of South Africa navigated by early Portuguese explorers.

rounds.name: Cook Strait
rounds.fact: Cook Strait connects the Tasman Sea with the South Pacific Ocean between New Zealand’s North and South Islands.
